verdicts.reason: A: the logo roundel is inflated into a big disc wedged between a tiny, illegible product bag and the body copy. It competes with the headline, dwarfs the product, and leaves the right half a cramped jumble (bag, logo, copy and CTA jammed together), while the headline breaks badly ('on / repeat'). B reads cleanly left to right (logo+headline, copy, CTA, product), but the SAVE badge floats untethered above the body copy, the product is cropped at the right edge, and the gap between headline and copy is large and uneven.
